title.zh: 宣布每年4月28日为奥罗拉省特别工作假日，以纪念Doña Aurora Aragon-Quezon逝世周年的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring April 28 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Province of Aurora to Commemorate the Death Anniversary of Doña Aurora Aragon-Quezon
title.orig: An Act Declaring April 28 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday in the Province of Aurora to Commemorate the Death Anniversary of Doña Aurora Aragon-Quezon
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 28 tháng 4 hằng năm là ngày làm việc lễ đặc biệt tại Tỉnh Aurora, nhân kỷ niệm ngày mất của Doña Aurora Aragon-Quezon
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 28 เมษายนของทุกปีเป็นวันทำงานพิเศษในจังหวัด Aurora เนื่องในโอกาสครบรอบการถึงแก่อสัญกรรมของ Doña Aurora Aragon-Quezon
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 28 April setiap tahun sebagai hari kerja khusus di Provinsi Aurora, dalam rangka memperingati hari wafat Doña Aurora Aragon-Quezon
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 28 April setiap tahun sebagai hari bekerja khas di Wilayah Aurora, sempena memperingati hari kematian Doña Aurora Aragon-Quezon

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2022/ra_11799_2022.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: April 28 of every year is hereby declared a special working holiday in the Province of Aurora to commemorate the death anniversary of Doña Aurora Aragon-Quezon.
The local government of the Province of Aurora shall plan and implement appropriate ceremonies for the annual observance of the death anniversary of Doña Aurora Aragon-Quezon.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
